每合成4次【逐鹿】英雄，获得1张随机1-5阶效果锦囊牌。

棋手升到5级后，你获得的战术牌都会变为高阶战术。
[Zhuolu] During the release of the skill, the hero will gain a shield of 5% of his maximum health every 1 second, and the shield lasts for 3 seconds.

Heroes revived during combat gain 200% Attack Speed, 100% critical rate and 70% damage reduction for 1.5 seconds.
你在战斗过程中复生的英雄，获得200%攻速、100%暴击率和70%伤害减免，持续1.5秒。
Obtain 1 Li Bai. Every time Li Bai obtains 12 ancient coins, he will permanently release 1 additional time when releasing his skills.
获得1张李白，李白每获得12次古币，释放技能时会永久额外释放1次。

每出售4名场上英雄获得1张古币，每出售1张古币获得1张【河洛】英雄牌。

回合开始时，获得1张【逐鹿】英雄牌；若上场战斗胜利，再获得1张场上【逐鹿】英雄的同名牌。

战斗开始时，穹顶会将区域内英雄的护盾吸收变为自身的护盾，保护区域内的友军不受伤害。

获得1张望梅止渴。回合开始时，场上每有2名【大河】英雄，再获得1张。
No camp hero is sacrificed: Summon a hero of the same tier and level as yourself (no card effect) to join the battle.
无阵营英雄获得牺牲：召唤1名与自身品阶和等级相同的英雄（无卡牌效果）参战。
At the beginning of the battle, if you have at least 2 [Great Riverlands] heroes, randomly summon a Totem of Destiny in a space around them: destroy the enemy who defeated the totem.
战斗开始时，若你至少有2名【大河】英雄，随机在其周围1格召唤命运图腾：消灭击败该图腾的敌人。
At the beginning of the battle, the friendly units 1 square around the totem will increase their maximum health by 10% and their attack speed by 20%, which can be superimposed.
战斗开始时，图腾周围1格的己方单位提高10%生命值上限和20%攻速，可叠加。

Obtain 1 Ancestral Bear Spirit, which is regarded as the [Great Riverlands] hero and does not account for the population. At the beginning of the battle, for every unit our side has more than the enemy's, the Ancestral Bear Spirit will be permanently increased by 2 levels.

使用古币时，其他每个阵营中各1名随机英雄等级+3。

Summon the Ancient Coin Machine, and each time you use 4 ancient coin cards on it (exquisite ancient coins are regarded as 2 times), you will get: 5 random Heluo hero cards; 1 piece of Sage's Asylum. Then you will randomly get: 1 super-speed growth card, 1 common equipment card or 8 energy.
召唤古币机，每对其使用4张古币牌（精致古币视为2次），依次获得：随机5张河洛英雄牌；1件贤者的庇护。之后随机获得：1张超速成长、1张普通装备牌或8能量。

获得2张古币。战斗胜利时，古币牌提供的等级永久+1。

场上的图腾被摧毁时，等级最高的【大河】英雄获得图腾一半等级的临时等级。

获得1张盗火。回合开始时，再获得1张（转瞬。指定1名英雄，至多偷取阿科米亚核心20级）。

每打出3张无阵营英雄牌时，全体英雄等级+4。

貂蝉、婉儿共战时二人共享法力值（不会变更），技能变为融合技，可对目标造成伤害及负面效果。

获得1张貂蝉和1张上官婉儿。共战时，参与击败敌方英雄后，二人均+10点法术攻击力并+1级。

出售场上英雄时，阿科米亚核心会获得其等级。

Randomly obtain 3 level 3-4 [Sunset Sea] hero cards.
随机获得3张3-4阶【日落海】英雄牌。

Restores 10 player health points. After that, every player who is eliminated will get 2 level 5 hero redemption coupons.

The number of people who can enter the battle +1, and you will get 2 lucky cards to share.
可上阵人数+1，同时获得2张有福同享。
At the beginning of the battle, 3 random heroes of your own will temporarily receive 2 pieces of common equipment and a maximum life limit of 300 points.
战斗开始时，随机3名己方英雄临时获得2件普通装备及300点生命上限。
Get 1 talent card Delayed gratification: Designate a hero whose level is +10. After 3 rounds, it will be +25.
获得1张天赋牌延迟满足：指定1名英雄等级+10。3回合后，再+25。
Get 1 basic equipment card. At the beginning of the battle, your hero wearing at least 2 pieces of equipment will receive 15% damage bonus and reduction.
获得1张基础装备牌。战斗开始时，你至少穿戴2件装备的英雄获得15%伤害加成和减免。
At the beginning of the battle, if you have at least 6 heroes of the same camp, they will gain 50 points of physical attack and magic attack and 50% attack speed.
战斗开始时，若你至少有6名同阵营英雄，其获得50点物攻和法攻以及50%攻速。
At the beginning of the round, 3 player health points are restored; if the player's health points are full, 4 player experience points are gained instead.
回合开始时，恢复3棋手生命值；若棋手生命值已满，改为获得4棋手经验。
Randomly obtain 3 level 4-5 hero cards.
随机获得3张4-5阶英雄牌。
Obtain 1 purchasable talent: spend 8 energy, the number of people available for battle +1. Can be purchased 3 times.
获得1个可购买天赋：花费8能量，可上阵人数+1。可购买3次。
Obtain 1 hero card with the Preparation effect. At the beginning of the round, get 1 more card.
获得1张整备效果英雄牌。回合开始时，再获得1张。
Get 1 hero card with sacrifice effect. At the beginning of the round, get 1 more card.
获得1张牺牲效果英雄牌。回合开始时，再获得1张。
Play a level 3 hero card and get an extra +6 levels.
打出3阶英雄牌，额外+6级。
Get 1 hero card with the on-entry effect. At the beginning of the round, get 1 more card.
获得1张登场效果英雄牌。回合开始时，再获得1张。

Obtain Chaos Rift: Summon a rift at a designated position, swallow the hero before the battle, and permanently obtain double its level. When the war begins, summon a fully equipped hero whose level is ≥ the store level.
获得混沌裂隙：指定阵位召唤裂隙，开战前吞噬英雄，永久获得其双倍等级。开战时，召唤1名品阶≥商店等级的满装备英雄。
At the beginning of the battle, if you only have level 1-3 heroes, you will randomly get a hero card on the field.
战斗开始时，若你只有1-3阶英雄，随机获得1张场上的英雄牌。
Get 1 Two People Walking Together. At the beginning of the round, if the player is not above level 3, he will get another 1 card.
获得1张双人同行。回合开始时，若棋手不超过3级，再获得1张。
The player's health is -20 and he gains 25 energy.
棋手生命值-20，获得25能量。
Obtain 15 player health points, 1 equipment box, and 1 level 5 exchange coupon.
获得15棋手生命值、1张装备箱、1张5阶兑换券。
For every 3 cards bought in the store, you will get 1 energy; if the sum of their tiers equals 10, you will get 1 more of them randomly.
在商店每买3张牌，获得1能量；若其品阶相加等于10，随机再获得其中1张。
Get 1 Big Star: Randomly put into battle a level 5 hero who is not present and whose level is Chess Player level
获得1张大明星：随机上阵1名不在场的等级为棋手等级x7的5阶英雄，其觉醒进度为1，此后每经过2回合则额外+1。
At the beginning of the battle, if you have at least 3 level 4-5 heroes, you will get 1 level 4-5 effect kit.
战斗开始时，若你至少有3名4-5阶英雄，获得1张4-5阶效果锦囊。
At the beginning of the round, the awakening progress of a random hero will be +1, but the level of the hero's synthetic improvement will be -1.
回合开始时，随机1名英雄觉醒进度+1，但英雄合成提升的等级-1。
When the player is level 4, he will get 1 talent card. Senior Headhunter: Choose 1 of 2 level 4 cards, and divide the selected card into four.
棋手4级时，获得1张天赋牌资深猎头：4阶卡牌2选1，并将选中的卡牌一分为四。
Obtain a level 3 exchange coupon. At the beginning of the round, gain 2 player experience. After reaching full level, you will gain 2 energy instead.
获得1张3阶兑换券。回合开始时，获得2棋手经验。满级后，改为获得2能量。
Obtain an Arthur and choose between card breakthrough and skill breakthrough for Arthur.
获得一张亚瑟，为亚瑟在卡牌突破和技能突破中二选一。
Gain 1 Karate talent card. Designate a hero and remove its equipment slots. At combat start, that hero gains temporary levels equal to its true level.
获得1张天赋牌空手道：指定一名英雄，取消装备槽位。战斗开始时，该英雄获得等同于其真实等级的临时等级。
Equipment cards can be sold for 3 energy, and effect cards can be sold for 1 energy.
装备卡可以售卖3能量，效果卡可以售卖1能量。
For every 3 ancient coin cards sold, you will get 1 Unyielding Will.
每出售3张古币牌，获得1张不屈意志。
Gain 1 Ma Chao. During combat, Ma Chao shares his critical rate with allies. When his critical rate reaches 100%, all allies’ spell damage can critically strike.
获得1张马超，战斗中，马超的暴击率始终会分享给友军。马超暴击率达到100%时，所有友军的法术伤害可以暴击。

name: Wo Men Ji Ge Zhen Qiang

effect_copies: When Sun Bin, Mozi, Bian Que, and Luban No. 7 released their skills, a substitute appeared to release their skills simultaneously.
孙膑、墨子、扁鹊、鲁班七号释放技能时，出现一个替身同步释放技能。

Get 1 Lessio and 1 Mengya. When fighting together, the two share mana (which will not change), and their skills become fusion skills (see the skill panel for details). Each time an enemy hero is defeated, their levels will be +1.
获得1张莱西奥和1张蒙犽。共战时二人共享法力值（不会变更），技能变为融合技（详见技能面板）。每次击败敌方英雄二人等级均+1。

Get 1 Lu Bu and 1 Xiang Yu. When fighting together, the two share health points (the sum of their health points), and equip themselves with [Fangtian Painted Halberd] and [Overlord Halberd] respectively (see the talent column for details).
获得1张吕布和1张项羽。共战时，二人共享生命值（二者生命值之和），并分别为自身装备【方天画戟】和【霸王戟】（详见天赋栏）。

Get 1 Ying Zheng and 1 Wu Zetian. At the beginning of preparations for war, if Ying Zheng and Wu Zetian are present at the same time, choose a ruling plan from the two, and each plan will be strengthened after selection.
获得1张嬴政和1张武则天。备战开始时，若嬴政和武则天同时在场，二选一种统治方案，每种方案选择后会得到强化。
Get 1 Jiang Ziya and 1 Old Master. When both are present, you will get 1 [Oracle] for every 2 hero combinations. Get 1 [Commandment] for every 3 effect cards used.
获得1张姜子牙和1张老夫子。同时在场时，每2次英雄合成获得1张【神谕】。每使用3张效果牌获得1张【诫律】。
During the battle, when you trigger the hero's sacrifice effect for the fourth time, all the sacrificed heroes who have died will be perfectly resurrected.
战斗中，你第4次触发英雄的牺牲效果时，所有已阵亡的牺牲英雄将会完美复生。

Get 1 Shen Mengxi and 1 Sun Bin. When fighting together, the upper limit of the two mana values ​​remains the same (take the lower value), and each time a skill is released, it will gain an additional level of +1.
获得1张沈梦溪和1张孙膑。共战时，二人法力值上限保持一致（取较低值），每次释放技能额外+1级。
At the start of each round, trigger Lady Sun’s card effect once.
每回合开始时，触发1次孙尚香卡牌效果。
At combat start, Ganjiang Moye gains a Source Chalice.
战斗开始时，干将莫邪获得1件【法源之杯】。

Gain 1 Arthur. At combat start, allied heroes within 1 tile of Arthur become Temple Knights. Arthur’s basic attacks heal the Temple Knight with the lowest health; his skill orders all Temple Knights to charge. The charge lasts 1.2 seconds and deals 50 + 5% maximum health physical damage to enemies along the path.
获得1张亚瑟，战斗开始时，亚瑟周围一格的友方英雄变身为圣殿骑士。亚瑟的普攻变为为血量最低的圣殿骑士回复生命值；技能改为指挥全体圣殿骑士朝敌人冲锋。 骑士冲锋：冲锋时长1.2秒；冲锋时，对路径敌人造成50+5%最大生命值的物理伤害。
After you buy a hero card, a mirror copy remains in the shop. It does not count toward the Secret task.
商店里的英雄牌在购买后会留下1个镜像复制（不计入秘技任务）。
Xiang Xiang gains an attack bonus of (the total level of your heroes × 0.5)%.
香香获得（己方英雄等级的总和×0.5）%的攻击力提升。
Gain 1 United as One card.
获得1张打成一片。
Enhance Master Ming’s hexagrams. Hexagram: Restraint grants 4 extra energy each round. Hexagram: Abundance grants 8 temporary refreshes each round.
强化明先生的卦象。 卦象·节：每回合额外获得4能量。 卦象·丰：每回合获得8次临时刷新。
Gain a stronger Eternal Time Loop that can record 12 hero or effect cards.
获得1张更强力的永恒时之回环，可以记录12张英雄牌或效果牌。
At combat start, copy the highest-level enemy hero and temporarily add the copy to your board.
战斗开始时，将敌方等级最高的英雄复制，临时加入我方战场。
Choose 1 of 3 bonuses.
从3个增益效果中选择1个。
Frozen heroes permanently gain 20 levels after thawing.
冻结的英雄，解冻后等级永久+20。
At combat start, all your heroes gain 500 maximum health, 60 Physical Attack and 60 Spell Power.
战斗开始时，你的全体英雄获得500点最大生命值、60点物理和法术攻击力。
Choose 1 talent that grants a mysterious power.
选择1个获取神秘力量的天赋。
Issue 1 Privileged Decision that affects all players. You receive an additional privileged benefit.
选择1个特权决策颁布，对所有玩家生效，并且自己额外享受特权效果。
The hero designated by Divine Moment gains 30% physical and spell lifesteal at combat start and immunity to crowd control other than suppression for 15 seconds.
封神一瞬指定的英雄在战斗开始时获得30%物理和法术吸血，并在15秒内免疫控制效果（压制除外）。
Choose 1 of 3 talents associated with your skill’s faction.
天赋3选1（技能选择阵营相关的天赋）。
Gain 1 Major Paranormal Detector Retrofit. At combat start, heroes connected by the aircraft randomly gain temporary levels equal to 10%–30% of their own level.
获得一张灵异探测大改装。战斗开始时，飞行器连接的英雄会随机获得自身10%-30%等级数的临时等级。
Choose 1 of 3 Maple Dance enhancements.
从3个枫叶舞强化中选择1项。
Gain 1 Prodigy card: designate a hero and gain 4 copies of that hero card.
获得1张奇才：指定1名英雄，获得4张该英雄牌。
At combat start, your largest group of heroes of the same tier gains a damage bonus of 1% × the number of Treasure cards you have played.
战斗开始时，你的人数最多的同品阶英雄获得1%×已打出宝藏牌数量的伤害提升。
At combat start, all your heroes gain a damage bonus of 0.7% × the number of Treasure cards you have played.
战斗开始时，你的全体英雄获得0.7%×已打出宝藏牌数量的伤害提升。
Gain 1 Dream Engine, replacing the shop with the Dream Shop. Gain another after losing a battle when your Chess Player has 30 health or less.
获得1张梦幻引擎：将商店替换为梦幻商店。若在棋手生命值≤30时战斗失败，则重复获得。
Choose 1 of 2 hero enhancements.
从2种英雄强化效果中选择1个。
Gain 3 performances of Graceful Melody.
获得3次惊鸿调演奏次数。

When Little Bunny grants levels, every 5 levels also grants one random bonus: 15% Attack Speed, 2% physical and spell lifesteal, or 2 physical and spell defense. Every 65 levels granted through Little Bunny’s Aid also grants 1 Bunny’s Blessing card.
小菟提供等级时，每5级使其额外获得1项随机属性：15%攻速/2%物理和法术吸血/2点物理和法术防御力。且每通过小菟助力提供65级时，获得1张小菟送福。
At combat start, teleport a random Tier 4–5 hero onto your board with temporary levels equal to the round number × 12 and 3 suitable items. Its card effect does not apply.
战斗开始时，随机传送1个4-5阶临时等级为回合数×12的英雄进入战场（不含卡牌效果），并携带3件适配装备。
At combat start, your highest-level hero gains 1,200 health, 120 Physical Attack and 120 Spell Power.
战斗开始时，你等级最高的英雄获得1200点生命值、120点物理和法术攻击力。
Little Deer gains 30 levels and 1 Deer’s Shelter item.
小鹿等级+30，并获得1件小鹿的庇护。
The first effect card played each round triggers twice.
每回合打出的第1张效果牌会触发2次。

abilities.name: Gentle Call
abilities.desc: Randomly gain one Tier 1-5 Instant Hero card.

abilities.name: Embrace of the Sea
abilities.desc: Every four rounds, gain Symphony of the Tide. It grants 5 levels to a random on-board hero, triggering 3 times. A hero obtained through Gentle Call gains 5 extra levels. Each use adds 2 triggers to subsequent uses. Task progress starts at 1 in round 1.

abilities.name: Rise and Fall
abilities.desc: At combat start, teleport a random Tier 4–5 hero onto your board with temporary levels equal to the round number × 12 and 3 suitable items. Its card effect does not apply.

abilities.name: 温柔呼唤
abilities.desc: 使用技能，随机获得1张1-5阶的转瞬英雄牌。

abilities.name: 海的拥抱
abilities.desc: 每经过4个回合，获得1张秘技牌潮汐的交响。潮汐的交响：场上随机英雄等级+5，触发3次，若对象为温柔呼唤的英雄则额外等级+5，每次使用后，触发次数+2。秘技任务第1回合进度为1。

abilities.name: 潮起潮落
abilities.desc: 战斗开始时，随机传送1个4-5阶临时等级为回合数×12的英雄进入战场（不含卡牌效果），并携带3件适配装备。

abilities.name: Supreme Decision Maker
abilities.desc: At game start, gain a Strategic Decision and gain another after the first Supreme Decision is issued.

abilities.name: Lord Supreme
abilities.desc: Every five rounds, gain a Supreme Decision Secret card.

abilities.name: Privileged Decisions
abilities.desc: Issue one privileged decision for all players; the player receives an additional benefit.

abilities.name: 最高决策者
abilities.desc: 比赛开始时，获得1张战略决策；第一次发布至高决策后，可以再获得1张。战略决策可从候选效果中选择1个，本场比赛持续生效。

abilities.name: 至高之主
abilities.desc: 每经过5个回合，获得1张秘技牌至高决策。从4个至高决策中选择1个颁布，对全场所有玩家生效，持续3个回合。

abilities.name: 特权决策
abilities.desc: 选择1个特权决策颁布，对所有玩家生效，并且自己额外享受特权效果。

abilities.name: Time Rewind
abilities.desc: Replays one non-awakened hero or effect card used in the previous round.

abilities.name: Time Magic
abilities.desc: After using eight hero or effect cards in one round, gain the Time Loop Secret card.

abilities.name: Time Treasure
abilities.desc: Gain Eternal Time Loop, which can record up to twelve cards.

abilities.name: 时光倒流
abilities.desc: 使用技能，回溯上回合使用过的非觉醒英雄牌和效果牌，随机触发其中1张。

abilities.name: 时间魔法
abilities.desc: 首次单回合使用8张英雄牌或效果牌，获得1张秘技牌时之回环。时之回环会记录之后使用的最多8张非觉醒英雄牌和效果牌，并在下回合开始时再次触发。

abilities.name: 时光宝藏
abilities.desc: 获得1张更强的永恒时之回环，可以记录最多12张英雄牌或效果牌，并在下回合开始时再次触发。

abilities.name: Heart Flutter
abilities.desc: Every four purchased cards, randomly gain one effect card.

abilities.name: Heartbeat
abilities.desc: After triggering Heart Flutter 5/4/3 times, gain Heart Gravity.

abilities.name: Infinite Charm
abilities.desc: The first effect card played each round triggers twice.

abilities.name: 怦然心动
abilities.desc: 每购买4张牌，随机获得1张效果牌。

abilities.name: 心动节拍
abilities.desc: 每触发5/4/3次怦然心动，获得1张秘技牌心之引力。心之引力：获得4次临时刷新，接下来4次刷新时商店里的牌购买消耗-1。

abilities.name: 魅力无限
abilities.desc: 每回合打出的第1张效果牌会触发两次。

abilities.name: Dream Game
abilities.desc: Gain one random effect card when Zhuang Xiaoyu levels up.

abilities.name: Dreams Come True
abilities.desc: At levels 5 and 6, gain the Dreamlike Secret card.

abilities.name: Engine Upgrade
abilities.desc: Gain Dream Engine and replace the shop with a Dream Shop. Effect cards in that shop cost 1 less energy.

abilities.name: 梦境游戏
abilities.desc: 升级时，随机获得1张效果牌。

abilities.name: 美梦成真
abilities.desc: 升到5级和6级时，各获得1张秘技牌如梦似幻。如梦似幻：消耗8能量，基于场上阵容获取一套梦幻手牌。

abilities.name: 引擎升级
abilities.desc: 获得1张梦幻引擎，将商店替换为梦幻商店，刷出的效果牌购买消耗-1。若棋手生命值不高于30时战斗失败，则重复获得。

abilities.name: All-Seeing Board
abilities.desc: At the start of this round’s combat, randomly copy one enemy hero.

abilities.name: Plan Ahead
abilities.desc: At rounds 4/8/12, gain Strategic Momentum. It costs 6 energy and copies all enemy heroes into your hand at combat start.

abilities.name: The Divine Move
abilities.desc: At combat start, copy one of the two highest-level enemy heroes temporarily.

abilities.name: 棋道万象
abilities.desc: 本回合战斗开始时，随机复制1名敌方英雄。

abilities.name: 谋而后定
abilities.desc: 第4/8/12回合，获得1张秘技牌驭势。驭势消耗6能量：战斗开始时，将敌方场上所有英雄复制进你的手牌。

abilities.name: 神之一手
abilities.desc: 开战时，随机从敌方等级最高的2名英雄中复制1名，临时加入我方战场。

abilities.name: Oracle Signs
abilities.desc: Choose one of two omens; the omen lasts three rounds.

abilities.name: Fortune from Heaven
abilities.desc: At rounds 6/11, gain the Fated Gift Secret card.

abilities.name: Dragon Ascending
abilities.desc: Enhances Master Ming’s omens.

abilities.name: 先知卦象
abilities.desc: 使用技能，从2种卦象中选择1个，持续3个回合。丰：每回合获得4次临时刷新，每回合能量-2。节：刷新费用+1，每回合能量+2。

abilities.name: 天降鸿运
abilities.desc: 第6/11回合，获得1张秘技牌命运馈赠，并从2个馈赠中选择1个。

abilities.name: 飞龙在天
abilities.desc: 强化卦象。节：每回合额外获得4能量。丰：每回合获得8次临时刷新。

abilities.name: Jade Melody
abilities.desc: After every three non-awakened hero cards, play a pipa technique based on the card pattern.

abilities.name: Find Your Tune
abilities.desc: After six pipa performances, gain the Falling Blossom Secret card, up to two times.

abilities.name: Echoes Around the Halls
abilities.desc: Improves the techniques generated by Jade Melody.

abilities.name: 霓裳曲
abilities.desc: 每打出3张非觉醒英雄牌，根据出牌类型以不同指法弹奏琵琶并触发效果：3张相同英雄牌使下个指法触发2次；3张同品阶英雄牌使场上等级最低的2名英雄获得等于棋手等级的等级；3张同阵营英雄牌获得1张随机转瞬英雄牌。

abilities.name: 自成曲调
abilities.desc: 累积弹奏6次琵琶，获得1张秘技牌惊鸿调，限2张。惊鸿调会使用记录的前6次指法弹奏并触发对应效果。

abilities.name: 余音绕梁
abilities.desc: 获得3次惊鸿调演奏次数。

abilities.name: Master Craftsman
abilities.desc: At game start and commander level 5, gain 1 Portable Mechanism. At levels 2/3/4, gain a random Thermal Trap, Electromagnetic Spring or Plasma Barrier.

abilities.name: Build Upgrade
abilities.desc: Gain construction options for traps, springs and barriers.

abilities.name: Finished Blueprint
abilities.desc: Improves the mechanisms constructed during the match.

abilities.name: 神匠
abilities.desc: 开局及棋手5级时各获得1张便携式机关。棋手等级达到2/3/4时，从热能陷阱、电磁弹簧、等离子屏障中随机获得1张。

abilities.name: 构筑升级
abilities.desc: 累积获得指定数量螺丝后，获得1张秘技牌构筑升级，至多10张。热能陷阱触发获得3个螺丝，电磁弹簧触发获得2个，等离子屏障被摧毁获得5个。构筑升级可指定场上1个机关升级效果。

abilities.name: 成品方案
abilities.desc: 从3种机关强化方案中选择1个：热能陷阱延时2秒爆炸并增加1格范围；电磁弹簧被友军触发时提供50%生命值上限护盾，护盾期间伤害+50%；等离子屏障生命+100%，三级屏障为左右1格友军提供复生效果。

abilities.name: Lovely Fawn
abilities.desc: Summon a beloved fawn; it gains levels each round and gains extra levels after a victory.

abilities.name: Super Cute Fawn
abilities.desc: Gain one of three Fawn Secret cards: Taunt, Heavy Armor or Twin.

abilities.name: Giant Plush
abilities.desc: Enhances the summoned fawn and its equipment options.

abilities.name: 可爱小鹿
abilities.desc: 游戏开始时召唤小鹿。小鹿每回合等级+2；若上回合战斗胜利，额外+4。

abilities.name: 超绝可爱小鹿
abilities.desc: 每经过3个回合，获得1张秘技牌神奇小鹿。可获得嘲讽、重装、双生、共鸣或奉献效果，分别提供周期嘲讽、装备能力、复制体、等级翻倍或阵亡后分配临时等级。

abilities.name: 巨型玩偶
abilities.desc: 小鹿等级+30，并获得1件小鹿的庇护。唯一：穿戴者所受伤害的30%转移到小鹿身上。

abilities.name: Infinite Mirror
abilities.desc: Gain a Mirror card; every four skill uses increase its energy cost by one.

abilities.name: Mirror Force
abilities.desc: After using four Mirrors, gain the Ten Thousand Mirrors Secret card.

abilities.name: Mirror Flower Shadow
abilities.desc: Purchased hero cards leave behind one mirror copy.

abilities.name: 无穷镜像
abilities.desc: 使用技能获得1张镜像牌；每使用4次技能，该技能能量消耗+1。镜像会自动变为上一张打出的英雄牌，不能复制其他镜像牌。

abilities.name: 镜像之力
abilities.desc: 使用4张镜像，获得1张秘技牌万镜。万镜：随机复制场上的4张英雄牌。

abilities.name: 镜花影
abilities.desc: 商店里的英雄牌在购买后会留下1个镜像复制，不计入秘技任务。

abilities.name: Party Bubble
abilities.desc: Choose one of two random factions; then spend one energy to gain a hero from that faction.

abilities.name: Happy Gathering
abilities.desc: Field six heroes from the chosen faction to gain Friends Everywhere, which grants 5 random Hero cards from that faction.

abilities.name: Party Time
abilities.desc: Gain a faction-related talent choice.

abilities.name: 派对泡泡
abilities.desc: 使用技能，从随机2个阵营中选择1个；之后技能替换为花费1能量获得1张该阵营英雄牌。

abilities.name: 快乐集结
abilities.desc: 上阵6名技能所选阵营英雄，获得1张秘技牌朋友多多。朋友多多：随机获得5张技能所选阵营的英雄牌。

abilities.name: 狂欢时刻
abilities.desc: 获得1张打成一片，从与技能所选阵营相关的3个天赋中选择1个。

abilities.name: Ultimate Crossbow
abilities.desc: Attacks enemies with a weapon. Starts at 20 attack and gains 20 per qualifying hero. The October 29 update shortens the opening artillery windup, speeds up shells and slightly increases their damage multiplier; exact values were not published.

abilities.name: Artillery
abilities.desc: At 10/15/20/30 player damage, gain Weapon Retrofit.

abilities.name: Full Firepower
abilities.desc: Attack increases by 0.5% of the total level of allied heroes.

abilities.name: 究极弩炮
abilities.desc: 战斗开始时使用武器攻击敌人。初始攻击力为20；每拥有1名不低于10级的1-3阶英雄，攻击力+20。10.29缩短炮击模式开战攻击前摇、增加炮弹弹道速度，并小幅增加伤害倍率；公告未公开具体数值。

abilities.name: 枪炮艺术
abilities.desc: 累积造成10/15/20/30点棋手伤害，获得1张秘技牌武器改造。武器改造：攻击力+20%，并进行1次武器改造方案选择。

abilities.name: 火力全开
abilities.desc: 获得（己方英雄等级总和x0.5）%的攻击力提升。

abilities.name: Maple Dance
abilities.desc: Maple Dance transfer enhancements: Unbound Maple clears negative effects and grants 5 seconds of crowd-control immunity. Crimson Inheritance passes 25% of a removed hero’s true level to the next Maple Dance hero, or 75% if sold, once. Maple Blade grants 20% bonus damage after transfer.

abilities.name: Dragon in Flight
abilities.desc: When the Maple Dance hero has defeated 3/5/9/15 enemy heroes, gain a Dance Step Secret card and unlock an enhancement.

abilities.name: Instant Dance
abilities.desc: Choose 1 of 3 Maple Dance enhancements.

abilities.name: 枫叶舞
abilities.desc: 枫叶舞转移强化：枫影无拘在转移后清除负面状态，并在5秒内免疫控制；红叶染锋在英雄被移除时保留25%真实等级给下一个枫叶舞英雄，被出售则保留75%，限一次；枫华之刃在转移后获得20%伤害加成。

abilities.name: 惊鸿游龙
abilities.desc: 枫叶舞指定的英雄累积击败3/5/9/15名敌方英雄，获得1张秘技牌翩跹舞步，并为枫叶舞解锁1项特性。

abilities.name: 即刻起舞
abilities.desc: 从3个枫叶舞强化中选择1项。

abilities.name: Special Paranormal Tracker
abilities.desc: Gain a Flyer; each point of Mystery Power grants it 2 spell power and a temporary level link.

abilities.name: Exorcise! Harder!
abilities.desc: At 5/10/20/35 Mystery Power, gain Paranormal Detector Retrofit. The first Secret only offers 2 random modules from Power Up, Rocket Ride and Targeted Destruction.

abilities.name: Super Link
abilities.desc: Improves the link between Angela’s Flyer and its connected hero.

abilities.name: 特制灵异追踪器
abilities.desc: 获得飞行器；棋手等级达到3时，获得1张顿悟时刻。

abilities.name: 驱鬼！加大力度！
abilities.desc: 累计获得5/10/20/35点神秘力量，获得1张秘技牌灵异探测大改装。首次秘技仅从上强度、坐火箭、定向毁灭中随机选择2个模块。

abilities.name: 超级连接
abilities.desc: 获得1张灵异探测大改装。战斗开始时，飞行器连接的英雄随机获得自身10%-40%等级数的临时等级。

abilities.name: Grand Household
abilities.desc: Start with three energy and regain three after each auction.

abilities.name: All for One
abilities.desc: Every 45 energy spent grants a Secret card that borrows another player’s Secret.

abilities.name: Phoenix Gathering
abilities.desc: Choose one Secret card from three other players.

abilities.name: 门庭赫奕
abilities.desc: 比赛开始时额外拥有3能量；每次拍卖后，再次获得3能量。

abilities.name: 众心所归
abilities.desc: 每使用45能量，获得1张秘技牌为我所用。为我所用：随机获得本局其他棋手的1张秘技牌。

abilities.name: 万鸟朝凤
abilities.desc: 随机从3个棋手的秘技牌中选1张。

abilities.name: Chosen Protagonist
abilities.desc: Use the skill to designate 1 hero as the protagonist. After you play every 2 Hero or Effect cards, that hero gains 1 level, up to 5 levels per round.

abilities.name: Apotheosis Moment
abilities.desc: When an allied hero reaches level 25 for the first time, gain Moment of Apotheosis. Designate 1 hero; whenever that hero permanently gains levels, it gains 1 additional level.

abilities.name: Perfect Performance
abilities.desc: At combat start, the hero designated by Moment of Apotheosis gains 30% physical and spell lifesteal and becomes immune to crowd control for 15 seconds, except suppression.

abilities.name: 钦定主角
abilities.desc: 使用技能，指定1名英雄成为主角。每打出2张英雄牌或效果牌，该英雄等级+1，每回合最多+5。

abilities.name: 封神时刻
abilities.desc: 己方英雄首次升到25级，获得1张秘技牌封神一瞬。封神一瞬：指定1名英雄，使其每次等级永久提升时都额外+1级。

abilities.name: 完美演出
abilities.desc: 封神一瞬指定的英雄在战斗开始时获得30%物理和法术吸血，并在15秒内免疫控制效果（压制除外）。

abilities.name: Xiaotu’s Aid
abilities.desc: Use the skill to have Xiaotu assist 1 random hero, granting it 2 levels. Each previous assist this match increases the levels granted by 1.

abilities.name: Rapid Rabbit Rise
abilities.desc: When the total level of your heroes reaches 50/175/400, gain 1 Xiaotu’s Blessing. It triggers Xiaotu’s Aid once on each of 4 random heroes, granting each 2 levels.

abilities.name: Moonlit Special Blend
abilities.desc: For every 5 levels Xiaotu grants, the target also gains one random bonus: 15% Attack Speed, 2% physical and spell lifesteal, or 2 physical and spell defense. Gain 1 Xiaotu’s Blessing whenever Xiaotu’s Aid has granted a total of 65 levels.

abilities.name: 小菟助力
abilities.desc: 使用技能，小菟随机助力1名英雄，使其等级+2。本场比赛中，小菟每助力过1次，等级提升效果+1。

abilities.name: 兔飞猛进
abilities.desc: 己方英雄等级总和达到50/175/400级，获得1张秘技牌小菟送福。小菟送福：对场上随机4名英雄各触发1次小菟助力，使其等级+2。

abilities.name: 月之特调
abilities.desc: 小菟提供等级时，每5级使目标额外获得1项随机属性：15%攻速、2%物理和法术吸血，或2点物理和法术防御。每通过小菟助力提供65级，获得1张小菟送福。

abilities.name: Heart of Ice
abilities.desc: Designate 1 hero and freeze it. After combat, it transforms into a random hero 1 tier higher and retains its level.

abilities.name: Extreme Freeze
abilities.desc: On rounds 5 and 8, gain 1 Deep Freeze. Choose 1 of 3 random enhancements. At round start, Ice Domain grants levels equal to twice the Tier 5 hero count; Cold Rain uses the majority-faction count +2; Cold Resonance uses twice the awakened hero count.

abilities.name: Frozen Treasure
abilities.desc: Choose 1 of 3 bonuses: Frost Tide grants your highest-level hero 1,200 health and 120 Physical Attack and Spell Power at combat start; Immortal Ice grants all allied heroes 500 maximum health and 60 Physical Attack and Spell Power; Blizzard Moment makes frozen heroes permanently gain 20 levels after thawing.

abilities.name: 冰之心
abilities.desc: 指定1名英雄，将其冻结。战斗结束后，该英雄随机变为更高1阶的英雄，继承等级。

abilities.name: 极寒冰冻
abilities.desc: 第5/8回合，获得1张秘技牌深度冻结，从随机3个强化效果中选择1个。回合开始时的强化：冰心领域按5阶英雄数量×2提供等级；寒雨凝结按主要阵营人数+2提供等级；寒潮共振按已觉醒英雄数量×2提供等级。

abilities.name: 冰雪秘藏
abilities.desc: 从3个增益效果中选择1个：寒潮之势使等级最高的英雄在战斗开始时获得1200生命值和120物理、法术攻击力；不朽坚冰使全体英雄获得500最大生命值和60物理、法术攻击力；雪暴时刻使冻结英雄解冻后等级永久+20。

abilities.name: Inspired Stroke
abilities.desc: After every 4 hero fusions, gain 1 Improvisation. Improvisation grants a copy of 1 random hero on the board.

abilities.name: Born a Genius
abilities.desc: After using 6 Improvisations, gain 1 Inspiration Burst. It releases 3 sword waves at 3 random non-awakened Hero cards in your hand, splitting each into 2 Instant copies.

abilities.name: Peerless Talent
abilities.desc: Gain 1 Prodigy. Designate 1 hero and gain 4 copies of that Hero card.

abilities.name: 神来之笔
abilities.desc: 每进行4次英雄合成，获得1张即兴创作。即兴创作：随机获得场上1名英雄的复制。

abilities.name: 天生我才
abilities.desc: 使用6张即兴创作，获得1张秘技牌灵感爆发。灵感爆发：释放3道剑气，斩击手牌中随机3张非觉醒英雄牌，将每张牌斩为2张转瞬版复制。

abilities.name: 惊才绝艳
abilities.desc: 获得1张奇才：指定1名英雄，获得4张该英雄牌。

abilities.name: Treasure Hunt
abilities.desc: After Marco plays every 4 Hero cards of Tier 3 or lower, gain 1 random Treasure card.

abilities.name: Ultimate Treasure
abilities.desc: After using 7 Treasure cards, gain 1 Ultimate Treasure. Choose 1 of 3 random Ultimate Treasures.

abilities.name: Share the Treasure
abilities.desc: Choose 1 of 2 hero enhancements: Sunshine grants all allied heroes a damage bonus equal to 0.7% times the number of Treasure cards played; Special Attention grants the largest same-tier group of allied heroes a damage bonus equal to 1% times that number.

abilities.name: 寻宝之旅
abilities.desc: 每打出4张3阶及以下的英雄牌，随机获得1张宝藏牌。

abilities.name: 终极宝藏
abilities.desc: 使用7张宝藏牌，获得1张秘技牌终极宝藏，并从随机3个终极宝藏中选择1个。

abilities.name: 瓜分宝藏
abilities.desc: 从2种英雄强化效果中选择1个：阳光普照使全体英雄获得已打出宝藏牌数量x0.7%的伤害提升；重点照顾使人数最多的同品阶英雄获得已打出宝藏牌数量x1%的伤害提升。

rule_notes: Preparation effects resolve during the preparation phase; order follows the card text and recorded tests.
准备阶段执行由卡面标注的效果，结算顺序以卡面原文和实测为准。
Effects marked for combat start resolve before normal attacks and ongoing effects.
战斗开始时触发的效果，通常先于普通攻击和持续效果。
Triggers when a hero card or summoned unit enters the board.
英雄牌或召唤物进入战场时触发。
The post-combat victory timing used by rewards and level effects.
战斗胜利后的结算时点，可影响奖励和等级。
Triggers when a unit leaves the board, is defeated or removed.
单位离开战场、被击败或被移除时触发。
Level changes health, attack and dynamic skill values.
等级会改变生命、攻击和技能中的动态数值。
A level increase that lasts for the current combat or stated rounds.
只在当前战斗或指定回合有效的等级提升。
A level increase written to the unit record for the rest of the match.
写入单位成长记录并持续到本局结束。
The resource and cap used by skills, Secrets and some summons.
技能、秘技和部分召唤物使用的资源及上限。
Adds an independent summon to the board; its own stats are used.
把独立召唤物加入战场，并按召唤物自己的属性计算。
Awakened card faces replace skill text and some stats; do not mix forms.
觉醒卡面会替换技能文本和部分属性，不能与普通形态混算。
Choose from candidate cards and resolve resource, hero or upgrade effects.
从候选卡牌中选择并结算资源、英雄或强化效果。
